input.quote: This Agreement shall be automatically renewed for an additional one year period on each anniversary of the Effective Date, unless terminated by either Party hereto upon ninety (90) days written notice to the other.
input.rationale: Section 4.1 (p0024) is the only renewal provision in the Agreement. Renewal terms are one year each, which is acceptable, but the only exit is 90 days' written notice, i.e. a 90-day non-renewal notice window that fails the fallback ceiling of 60 days (and sits at the edge of walk-away territory). The Agreement contains no renewal price-uplift right (fees are a fixed 30% share of Net Sales under Section 3.1), so the price-cap element is not triggered. We therefore target the fallback and shorten the window to 60 days; the preferred 30-day opt-out plus a 60-day vendor reminder is noted as our better position but not pressed.

mappings.element: If renewal is automatic, Customer's non-renewal notice window is no more than 60 days.
If renewal permits price increases, each increase is capped at 5 percent.
mappings.quote: The Company shall pay HDI thirty percent (3016) of the Net Sales in excess of Eleven Thousand Dollars ($11,000) per calendar month.

proposal.summary: Shorten the non-renewal notice window in Section 4.1 from 90 days to 60 days.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] The one-year term auto-renews annually but can only be exited on 90 days' notice, so we have shortened that window to 60 days, which is our fallback position (our preferred position is 30 days' notice with a 60-day renewal reminder).
